name: ProductBoxes – Mix & Match Box Builder for WooCommerce
author: BestWebExpert

sections.description:
ProductBoxes – Mix & Match Box Builder for WooCommerce is a free WooCommerce box builder that lets customers build their own box, mix and match products, create custom gift boxes and buy product bundles. Shoppers choose eligible products, fill box slots, see live pricing and discount progress, and add their completed box to the cart. Create gift hampers, clothing bundles, snack boxes, beauty kits, samplers, or “pick any 3” offers without coding.

Try ProductBoxes and preview the live WooCommerce box builder demos:

  • Explore ProductBoxes – See the Free WooCommerce Box Builder Features
  • Live Demo: Build Your Own Capsule Wardrobe Box – Watch Discounts Grow
  • Live Demo: Gift Box Builder – Pick Products, Add Wrap and a Gift Message
  • Live Demo: Mix & Match Shirt Bundle – Pick Any 3 for One Price

Watch the ProductBoxes demo video:

Set up a mix and match campaign in the visual editor, choose products and bundle discount rules, and publish with a Gutenberg block or shortcode. ProductBoxes calculates and validates prices on the server. 100% free: no paid version, locked features or account required.

Three ways to build WooCommerce product bundles

  • Tiered discount box builder: Offer bigger savings as shoppers add more items (for example, 10% off 3, 15% off 5 and 25% off 12). Show progress toward the next tier.
  • Fixed-size gift box builder: Let customers choose a box size, such as 3, 6 or 12 items, with a price or discount for each size.
  • Fixed-price mix and match bundles: Sell an exact number of eligible products for one bundle price, such as “pick any 3 shirts for $120”.

Features for your WooCommerce box builder

  • Build your own box: Customers choose products from a visual grid with categories, filters and sorting.
  • Mix and match products: Allow simple products and individual product variations.
  • Flexible bundle discounts: Configure tiered savings, fixed box sizes or fixed bundle prices.
  • Custom gift boxes: Offer optional gift wrapping, gift fees and a personal gift message.
  • Product selection rules: Choose eligible items manually, by category or by tag, with per-product limits.
  • Live box summary: Show selected items, box slots, totals and the next discount tier.
  • Mobile-friendly shopping: Use a sticky summary bar and bottom sheet on smaller screens.
  • Edit box in cart: Let shoppers update their choices before checkout.
  • Campaign scheduling: Set start and end dates; show a countdown only when a real end date exists.
  • Out-of-stock handling: Show unavailable products as sold out or hide them.
  • WooCommerce checkout: Support classic Cart/Checkout and WooCommerce Cart and Checkout blocks.
  • Order and inventory management: Save box contents, discounts and gift messages to orders and emails; reduce stock for purchased items.
  • Store owner analytics: Track views, product picks, conversions, revenue, discounts and top products in your own database.
  • Easy setup: Use the campaign editor, live preview, Gutenberg block or shortcode.
  • HPOS support: Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.

Use cases: gift boxes, product boxes and bundles

Use the WooCommerce mix and match builder for custom gift boxes, pick-and-mix snack boxes, bakery assortments, coffee or tea samplers, beauty kits, capsule wardrobe boxes, clothing bundles, holiday gift hampers and build-your-own product bundles. Choose tiered discounts, fixed box sizes or a bundle price to match the offer.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.6 or later
  • WooCommerce 9.0 or later
  • PHP 7.4 or later

External services

This plugin does not connect to any external service. It makes no requests to other servers and uses no CDN, remote fonts, telemetry, or licence or update checks. All scripts, styles and fonts are included in the plugin.

Privacy

Optional builder analytics are stored only in this site’s database. They record builder views, product picks, tier milestones, cart additions and box purchases.

  • A random session ID is kept in the browser’s sessionStorage. No tracking cookie is set.
  • Only a daily salted hash of that ID is stored. No IP address or user agent is recorded, and the salt changes every day, so sessions cannot be linked across days.
  • The analytics setting and the mmbb_track_events filter stop all collection, including new purchases. Refund and cancellation corrections still apply when tracking is off.
  • Raw events are deleted after the retention period (90 days by default). Daily totals and order-line sales records are kept for reports and late refunds.

Gift messages are stored with WooCommerce order items. The WordPress personal data tools export them, and erase them when WooCommerce’s order data removal setting allows it.

Source code and build

The JavaScript and CSS source is included in the src/ folder, with the build configuration in package.json and webpack.config.js. React and the @wordpress packages are supplied by WordPress and are not bundled.

To build with Node.js 20.19 or later:

npm install
npm run build

The build writes production files to build/. Composer is used only for development tools (coding standards and PHPUnit) and is not needed to run the plugin.

Public repository: https://github.com/Razibul-Hasan/productboxes-mix-and-match-box-builder

Developer hooks and filters

  • mmbb_campaign_config_defaults (filter): the config a blank campaign starts from. The result is sanitized again.
  • mmbb_templates (filter): the templates in the new campaign picker. Each is an array with id, title, type_label, description, art and a partial config.
  • mmbb_pricing_quote (filter): a box quote after the pricing engine has run. Arguments: the quote, the campaign config, the items and the options. Amounts are integer minor units (for example cents).
  • mmbb_campaign_saved (action): fires after a campaign is saved. Arguments: the campaign ID and the sanitized config.
  • mmbb_ensure_container_product (filter): called when a campaign goes live. Return the hidden container product ID, a WP_Error to stop publishing, or null. Arguments: the current value and the campaign ID.
  • mmbb_track_events (filter): return false to stop all analytics collection.

Credits

The Figtree and Bricolage Grotesque fonts are bundled locally under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Licence files: assets/fonts/Figtree-OFL.txt and assets/fonts/BricolageGrotesque-OFL.txt.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce 9.0 or later.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New, search for “ProductBoxes”, then install and activate the plugin. Or upload productboxes-mix-and-match-box-builder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. In the WordPress admin, open ProductBoxes and choose Create campaign.
  4. Select eligible products, your mix and match box type, pricing rules and storefront design; publish the campaign.
  5. Choose a page, insert the ProductBoxes Box Builder block, or add [mmbb_box id="12"] (replace 12 with your campaign ID).

Each site in a multisite network uses its own settings.
sections.faq:
What is a WooCommerce mix and match box builder?

A mix and match box builder lets customers choose from eligible products to create their own box or bundle. ProductBoxes supports build-your-own boxes, custom gift boxes, tiered discounts, fixed box sizes and fixed-price product bundles.

Is this WooCommerce gift box builder really free?

Yes. ProductBoxes includes every current feature for free, with no premium upgrade, license key or account required.

Can I preview the box builder before installing?

Yes. Try the capsule wardrobe box demo for tiered discounts, the gift box builder demo for box sizes and gift messages, or the shirt bundle demo for fixed-price bundles.

Can I sell “pick any 3” or other fixed-price product bundles?

Yes. Choose the Bundle price campaign type, set the number of items and one bundle price, and choose which products shoppers may mix and match.

Can customers build a gift box with a message and gift wrap?

Yes. Create a fixed-size or other supported box campaign and enable the optional gift message and gift wrap fee.

Can shoppers choose product variations?

Yes. Simple WooCommerce products and individual variations can be included in a box.

How do I display the product box builder on a page?

Publish a campaign and choose its page, insert the ProductBoxes Box Builder block, or use [mmbb_box id="12"]. Optional shortcode attributes: layout (panel, bar or both), columns (3, 4 or 5) and hero (true or false).

Does the box builder work with my theme and on mobile?

The builder uses scoped styles inside your theme’s content area and was tested with Twenty Twenty-Five and Storefront. Narrow screens use a two-column product grid, a sticky summary bar and a mobile bottom sheet.

Is ProductBoxes compatible with WooCommerce Cart and Checkout blocks?

Yes. Box contents, discounts, gift messages, next-discount hints and the Edit box link work in classic and block carts. Locked item quantities in the “Box plus each item” cart mode are fully supported in the classic cart.

Will it load scripts on every page?

By default, the plugin loads builder scripts and styles only on pages containing a box builder. You can change this in Settings.

How are taxes calculated for mixed product boxes?

By default, the box is one cart line using the hidden box product’s tax class (Standard unless changed). For items with different tax classes, choose “Box plus each item” in Cart settings so each item uses its own tax class.

What is the hidden Box container product?

Each published campaign has a hidden WooCommerce container product for the cart. ProductBoxes manages its name and price; edit the campaign rather than the container. It is trashed with the campaign.

What if WooCommerce is deactivated?

ProductBoxes remains inactive and shows a dismissible notice on the Plugins screen to users who can activate plugins.

Does ProductBoxes delete data when uninstalled?

No. Data remains unless you enable “Delete all plugin data” in Settings. WooCommerce orders are never deleted. On multisite, each site’s setting is off by default.

Does the plugin send visitor information to an external service?

No. Optional analytics stay in your site’s database and do not record visitor IP addresses or user agents. See the Privacy and External services sections.

Are developer hooks and source files available?

Yes. JavaScript and CSS source, build instructions and mmbb_ filters/actions are documented below.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: tiered, fixed-size and bundle-price box campaigns, storefront builder block and shortcode, classic and block cart and checkout support, order and email details, analytics and settings.
